subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the tree on the left near the entrance of Zora's River makes a Skulltula fall out, rewarding GOLD SKULLTULA [019] when defeated.

evidence.quote:
Run up and roll into it to make a 
Skulltula fall out of the tree.  Defeat this enemy and you will receive GOLD 
SKULLTULA [019].

subject: Magic Bean
text: A man sitting along the path offers to sell Link a MAGIC BEAN for ten Rupees.

evidence.quote:
He offers to sell you a MAGIC BEAN for ten Rupees, and that's a pretty good 
deal, so take him up on his offer and buy one.

subject: Magic Bean
text: Each Magic Bean purchased increases in price by ten Rupees, costing a total of 550 Rupees to buy all of them.

evidence.quote:
Every Magic Bean that 
you buy is more expensive than the last by ten Rupees...If you wish to buy 
all of them now it's going to cost you a total of 550 Rupees so you would be 
making a few trips back and forth to fill your adult wallet.

subject: Chest
text: Dropping down the hole in the platform leads to a chest containing a RED RUPEE.

evidence.quote:
At the 
bottom open the chest to receive a RED RUPEE.

subject: Fairy Fountain
text: Blowing up the large boulder surrounded by small rocks with a bomb reveals the entrance to a Fairy Fountain.

evidence.quote:
Here you will find a large boulder surrounded by small rocks.  If you place a 
bomb beside this boulder and blow it up, it will reveal the way to a Fairy 
Fountain in case you need to restore your health or anything like that.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Link can jump and glide down with a Cucco to reach PIECE OF HEART [011].

evidence.quote:
Now from here you can jump and glide down to get the PIECE OF 
HEART [011].

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Jumping down and gliding west with a Cucco from the highest path allows Link to obtain PIECE OF HEART [012].

evidence.quote:
When you turn 
around and face west you will see another heart piece, jump down with the 
Cucco so that you can glide and grab hold of the PIECE OF HEART [012].

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: On the ladder directly below where the Piece of Heart was collected, defeat the enemy to pick up GOLD SKULLTULA [020].

evidence.quote:
On the kind of northwest part of this little land bridge area, 
directly below where you collected the Piece of Heart there is a ladder and on 
that ladder is an enemy.  Defeat this enemy and pick up the GOLD SKULLTULA 
[020].

subject: Frogs
text: Standing on the log and playing Saria's Song, Zelda's Lullaby, the Sun's Song, or Epona's Song rewards Link with a PURPLE RUPEE for each song.

evidence.quote:
Stand on this 
place and pull out your Fairy Ocarina.  Play Sari's Song and the frogs will 
reward you with a PURPLE RUPEE.  Play Zelda's Lullaby to get a PURPLE RUPEE, 
then the Sun's Song to get a PURPLE RUPEE and finally Epona's Song to get a 
PURPLE RUPEE.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: After collecting twenty Skulltulas, a man in the House of Skulltula gives Link the STONE OF AGONY.

evidence.quote:
There should be another guy here with a 
broken curse since you have collected twenty Skulltulas.  He gives you the 
STONE OF AGONY, a special item which makes your controller rumble when a 
special secret is nearby.

subject: Zora's Domain
text: Standing on the grey square in front of the waterfall and playing Zelda's Lullaby opens the entrance to Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote:
When you stand in front 
of the waterfall you will find a special grey square, whip out your Fairy 
Ocarina on this particular spot and play the song which connects you to the 
royal family, Zelda's Lullaby (left, up, right, left, up, right.)

subject: Diving Game
text: Playing the Diving Game costs 20 Rupees and requires diving to collect all five Blue Rupees.

evidence.quote:
You will have the option of playing the Diving 
Game for 20 Rupees.  The Diving Game is one of the easiest minigames ever, 
your goal is to jump down into the water and collect all five of the Blue 
Rupees.

subject: Silver Scale
text: Collecting all five Blue Rupees in the Diving Game rewards Link with the SILVER SCALE, allowing him to dive for six seconds rather than three seconds.

evidence.quote:
After successfully collecting all five Blue Rupees, head back up to where you 
started the game and speak to the Zora there once again.  The Zora will reward 
you with a SILVER SCALE which allows you to dive for six seconds rather than a 
mere three seconds, this means of course that you can go deeper as well.

subject: Chest
text: Lighting the final two torches behind the waterfall causes a large treasure chest to appear containing PIECE OF HEART [013].

evidence.quote:
Behind the waterfall are two final torches and when these are lit, a large 
treasure chest will appear...Open the chest to get PIECE OF HEART [013].

subject: Letter
text: At the start of Lake Hylia, swimming down to the bottom allows Link to acquire the LETTER.

evidence.quote:
When you reach Lake Hylia you should notice something on the bottom of the 
lake directly in front of you at the start.  Swim down and pick it up to 
acquire the LETTER.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Speaking to the man at the counter of the Fishing Pond allows Link to go fishing for 20 Rupees.

evidence.quote:
Speak to the guy at the counter and tell him you wish to go fishing, it only 
costs 20 Rupees.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Catching a ten pound fish at the Fishing Pond rewards Link with PIECE OF HEART [014].

evidence.quote:
Once you eventually catch this fish go back and talk to the guy at the 
counter, as a reward for the ten pound fish you get PIECE OF HEART [014].

subject: Scarecrow's Song
text: Playing any eight notes on the Ocarina in front of the lower scarecrow causes the scarecrow to memorize the tune.

evidence.quote:
Stand in 
front of the lower scarecrow and play your Ocarina.  Any tune consisting of 
eight notes that you play, the scarecrow will memorize and you have to 
memorize it as well.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: During the night, a Skulltula appears on one of the pillars on the island, yielding GOLD SKULLTULA [021] when eliminated.

evidence.quote:
Swim over to this island and play the Sun's Song if it isn't 
nighttime already right now.  During the night a Skulltula appears on one of 
these pillars, eliminate it and then grab the GOLD SKULLTULA [021].
